title: Soft particles · Puffs that meet the floor and the walls
description: Soft particles (src/particles.ts, src/post.ts, docs/graphics.md): covering particles fade where they cut into the scene, using the post pass's depth prepass. Time is frozen and the camera zoomed in on Gerard's childhood home, Gerard hidden; each effect is shown with soft particles off (the old hard straight cut) and then on, from the same frozen frame: dust, smoke (poof), frost and soot on the floor, then in a corner against two walls. Last, a poof beside Gerard inside a street building's cut, which must not fade behind the walls the cut removed. Then the post pass is turned off (no depth: particles draw as before, nothing breaks) and on again.

steps.eval: window.sp = (play, frames, zoom = 1.8, hide = true) => { const g = window.gerard.game, app = g.app; app.timeScale = 0; g.effects.clear(); const me = app.root.findByName('Jugador'); me.enabled = !hide; const p = me.getPosition(); const c = { x: p.x, y: Math.max(g.effects.particles.groundAt(p.x, p.z), -1), z: p.z }; play(g.effects, (dx, dy, dz) => ({ x: c.x + dx, y: c.y + dy, z: c.z + dz })); for (let i = 0; i < frames; i++) app.fire('update', 1 / 60); app.root.findByName('Cámara isométrica').camera.orthoHeight = zoom; }; window.soft = on => { window.gerard.game.effects.particles.soft = on; };
sp((e, at) => e.particles.burst('dust', at(0, .05, 0), 22, { spread: .5, flat: true, speed: 1.3 }), 14); soft(false)
